verdict.rationale: Medusa's Product and Inventory Module docs plus the official JS SDK/Admin API imply catalog data can be created/updated programmatically at scale (medusa-docs-21, medusa-docs-8, medusa-probe-rt-2), and a community reviewer praises the 'nice backend GUI for managing inventory' (medusa-comm-3), but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of a CSV bulk import/export feature or a dedicated bulk-edit UI workflow. Missing for 10: explicit CSV import/export documentation, evidence of an admin bulk-edit interface, and independent confirmation that large catalogs can be updated without per-item edits.
